Use case: style-transfer. Input1 is the APPROVED manga Episode01 illustration and is the EDIT TARGET. Add restrained full manga COLOR while keeping its exact new composition, perspective, mature poet's identity and expression, foreshortened quill hand, blank open book, candle, stone room, window, night mountains, poses and objects unchanged. The user likes this new manga drawing and wants it a bit more colorful.
Keep bold black ink contours, clear black shadow shapes, stylized2D faces, simple folds and sparse screentones. Use flat clean color plus two-tone cel-shaded shadows, NOT painted/photorealistic modeling. Warm natural skin and candlelit amber highlights, dark umber hair with grey temples, deep petrol-teal cloak, cream tunic and book paper, warm brown desk, cool slate stone and muted indigo night sky. Moderate, cohesive saturation; keep linework legible and dramatic. No new brocade or ornamental patterns. Medieval Georgian/Eastern clothing. Exactly one poet.
Same landscape16:10 canvas, ideally1586x992, fullimagevisible. Bookpagesremaincompletelyblank. NO TEXT, LETTERS, NUMBERS, SPEECH BUBBLES, SOUND-EFFECT LETTERING, CAPTIONS, BANNERS, SCROLLS OR WATERMARKS.

Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: image1 is the APPROVED MANGA REDESIGN of Episode2, Tinatin's coronation, with FOUR people. Supporting style reference: image2 is Tinatin's coloured manga portrait; image3 is coloured Episode1. Add a moderate rich but restrained colour treatment while keeping the approved composition, manga ink contours, face construction and strong dramatic perspective. Do not convert to painted realism. Preserve all poses, gestures, architecture and FOUR characters only: seated young Tinatin at centre on raised throne, elderly Rostevan at right lowering the crown onto her head, young bareheaded Avtandil in left foreground, elderly Sograt in turban left background. Match Tinatin portrait's plum robe, cream trim and gold clasps, dark wavy hair and natural warm skin. Rostevan: white hair and beard, forest-green cloak over cream/gold garment. Avtandil: dark curls, warm olive skin, crimson cloak and cool steel Eastern armour. Sograt: white beard, muted teal/green turban and ochre robe. Hall: warm ivory and grey stone, golden sunlight behind crown, soft blue shadows; flat two-tone cel shading and selective screentones. Clean bold black ink must remain; colours support the drawing. No dense ornamental brocade, no photorealism. Output one opaque landscape16:10 PNG, requested1586x992, same composition framing. STRICTLY NO TEXT, LETTERS, NUMBERS, CAPTIONS, SFX, SPEECH BUBBLES, BANNERS, SCROLLS OR WATERMARKS. No added figures.
